text:
elinor: Heads-up: we opened Dedicated L4 capacity in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) and added new slots in us-west-2a. Rolling live now — capacity visible in Console + CLI. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/l4

sanjay: awesome — ETA for GA pricing update?

elinor: price tiering stays the same for now. L4 is in the 'balanced' band — see pricing matrix in the doc. We'll revisit after ~2 weeks of telemetry.

kevin: can you add a note for support playbook? customers are asking about perf vs A10/A100.

elinor: yup. I'll drop a support playbook snippet in #support in ~30m. Quick perf note: ~1.8x throughput vs T4 for short sequences, much better memory headroom for 8k+ context.

julia: any changes to reservation/allocation policy with the new pool?

elinor: yes — introducing a soft-quota + queueing policy for Dedicated pools. TL;DR: tenants get a soft allocation that auto-throttles after 70% of reserved vGPU usage; burst queue allows up to 90% if pool has spare capacity. Effective 2026-04-06. CLI to reserve: `rwctl dedicated reserve --pool l4-ap-sg --units 4 --duration 30d`

mike: will we throttle existing tenants immediately or only on renew?

elinor: on renew only. No retroactive evictions. Enterprise customers with explicit SLOs can request exemptions via support/SE.

sales-bot: Notifying account teams for customers with open Dedicated trials (tagging high-usage accounts).

kevin: request: can someone draft a short customer-facing note + tech appendix? Support needs it for incoming tickets.

sanjay: i'll prepare a one-pager and put it in /shared/dedicated-l4 (public to GTM). tagging @customer-success for review.

ops-bot: Scheduled background image-sync for l4 nodes: 2026-04-03 02:00-03:00 UTC. No customer impact expected; rolling updates will respect capacity SLOs. :calendar:

julia: noted. i'll update the release notes and put a console banner up closer to the effective date.

elinor: action items recap: (1) docs + pricing snippet (elinor), (2) support playbook (kevin + elinor), (3) sales comms one-pager (sanjay), (4) console banner (julia). Ping me if you want to co-author. :rocket:
